author: Lex Fridman
description:
Khabib Nurmagomedov is one of the greatest fighters of all time, who retired from the UFC undefeated with a perfect 29-0 record. We did this conversation entirely in Russian. It's translated and dubbed into English. Both language audio tracks (and subtitles) are available here on YouTube. To switch between language audio tracks, click: Settings gear icon, then Audio track.
